channel_count_table.note: indexed by the format index; entry 0 is never used

record.+0x0c: first channel, the value of table +0x18 before this entry (written at 00a872c0)
record.+0x10: format index (1 mono, 2 stereo, 3 five point one)

hazards: A top-level token that is none of Channels, Volume or Loop is never consumed, so the loop at 00a870f0 spins forever. It only terminates on end of file, on an empty token, or through one of the three keywords.

Inside a Channels block, a format token that is none of mono, stereo or 51 is also not consumed: the record is appended with a channel count of 0 and the next iteration reads that token as the next channel name.
